criteria.name: Usefulness for a fresher
criteria.description: A new student would genuinely benefit from this, on campus or in study.

criteria.name: Ease of use
criteria.description: A fresher can understand and use it in minutes, with no help: clear instructions, simple flow, no confusing steps.

criteria.name: Creativity
criteria.description: Original idea or a fresh angle on a known problem.

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.description: Clear live presentation and README: the team shows the project working and explains it simply.
